incident: Ontario DraftKings replaced pregame market type IDs at kickoff with 1_39, 2_39 and 3_39. The old parser dropped these primary full-game quotes despite a healthy connection. Recorded live payloads now cover this transition. Unsupported primary types surface warnings.

beforeFix.method: Three fixed rounds, official Ontario reference requests followed by all three public application league boards. Raw event participant roles and market runner roles establish sides independently. Source selection identities establish quote correspondence. No application source, normalizers, league catalog or team functions are imported. Every attempt and discrepancy is retained.

limits: Reference and application snapshots are close in time, not atomic; price movement may create transient differences, which remain recorded.
All main two-way moneyline, spread and total markets discovered in the three requested leagues are checked. Props and alternate lines are outside this check.
Pregame observations do not prove in-play update latency or suspension delivery.
Bookmaker kickoff differences are listed separately; canonical team/date/live identity and quote correctness are checked.
This script verifies raw market identity/side/line/price/availability. House-rule overtime and tie treatment require separately reviewed jurisdiction-specific rule documents.

liveStream.method: One read-only public college SSE connection observed for60seconds. Initial snapshot and all parsed frames retained. Exact price/line/suspension changes counted only between consecutive target states in delta frames. No independent upstream fetches or application normalizer imports.
limits: This proves public stream delivery and represented availability only; authoritative source accuracy is a separate audit.
No comparison against another application is performed.
A missing selection is recorded as missing and is never synthesized.
One60second observation cannot establish sustained reliability or a latency percentile.
Source checks compare nearby but non-atomic reads. The result proves consistency at these observations, not perpetual accuracy.
Connection readiness is league-wide; the UI now reports per-game main-price coverage separately.
The observed college stream carries real live changes; this does not establish NFL in-play behavior or bookmaker-to-browser latency.
